map.：采用 Gutenberg-Richter 关系 log₁₀E=4.8+1.5M: : uses the Gutenberg-Richter relation log₁₀E = 4.8 + 1.5M (E in joules); at M=6, log₁₀E = 13.8 and E = 10^13.8 ≈ 6.3x10¹³ J, about 15 kilotonnes of TNT. M=7 is about 2.0x10¹⁵ J, roughly 31.6 times the energy of 6.
